lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region, with local maxima arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern along four horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating distinctive grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal aspect to shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin exhibits a scattered distribution of small, high-luminance circular blobs across its leading and medial surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral region just posterior to the pectoral fin base.
